body:
다음 글을 읽고, 질문에 대한 답변의 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들 어갈 알맞은 말을 지문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so.
Q: What factors have led to the decline of group singing in modern times?
A: It is mainly because people prefer consuming music (A) _____ through individual gadgets, and the population has grown increasingly (B) _____ , resulting in a lack of familiar, common songs.
solution: (A) 사람들이 개인 기기로 음악을 사적으로 즐기게 되었음을 알 수 있으므로 'privately'가 가장 적절하다. (B) 사회가 다양해지면서 공통으로 아는 노래가 줄어들었으므로 'diverse'가 가장 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글에서 필자가 주장하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
Although group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be beneficial. So why does group singing make us feel so good? Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by reducing stress and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin. Singing with others has additional benefits. It brings people closer together and helps create bonds that can support self-esteem in a more stable way. The sense of belonging and purpose created in the moment makes us feel connected to others and to something greater. Thus, it's no surprise that people who sing together have healthier minds and more readily participate in their communities. A few studies have reported that people who sang in choirs were more optimistic, less lonely, had stronger relationships, and were more likely to contribute positively to their communities than those who didn't. The good news is that people can enjoy these benefits even when they're singing with others online. Being together is the key.
solution: ③ 글에서 함께 노래하는 것이 유대감을 형성하고 소속감을 주며 공동체 참여를 높인다는 내용이 반복적으로 제시되어 있으므로, 글의 주장으로 가장 적절하다. ① 도파민과 세로토닌 분비를 늘리는 방법에 관한 주장은 언급되지 않았다. 해당 호르몬들은 함께 노래하기의 효과를 설명하는 사례로만 쓰였다. ② 합창단(choir) 활동에 참여해야 한다는 주장은 언급되지 않았다. 합창단 연구는 함께 노래하기의 이점을 뒷받침하는 사례일 뿐이다. ④ 자존감을 높이기 위해 타인과의 관계를 먼저 개선해야 한다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 글 후반부에서 온라인으로 함께 노래할 때도 같은 이점을 누릴 수 있다고 명시하고 있으므로, 대면 모임을 강조하는 것은 글의 주장과 다르다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: 스트레스를 줄이려면 도파민과 세로토닌의 분비를 늘려야 한다.
건강한 정신을 위해 합창단 활동에 적극적으로 참여해야 한다.
함께 노래하는 활동을 통해 유대감과 공동체 의식을 키워야 한다.
자존감을 높이기 위해 타인과의 관계를 먼저 개선해야 한다.
온라인 노래 활동보다 대면 모임을 통해 공동체에 기여해야 한다.

글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절 한 곳을 고르시오.
Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. ( ⓒ ) The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. ( ⓓ ) We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. solution: 주어진 문장은 'Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances(큰 공간과 사회적 상황에서 연주되는 대신)'라는 대조의 표지를 포함하며, 음악이 개인 기기에서 사적으로 즐기는 것이 되었다는 내용이다. 따라서 이 앞에는 개인적으로 음악을 즐기게 만든 기술에 대한 내용이 마무리되어야 하고, 이 뒤에는 집단 내 노래가 줄어든 두 번째 이유로 자연스럽게 넘어가야 한다. ② 앞 문장인 'Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting'은 기술이 개인적인 음악 감상을 가능하게 했다는 내용이며, 주어진 문장은 이를 구체적으로 부연하여 음악이 사적인 기기에서 혼자 즐기는 것이 되었음을 설명한다. 또한 ② 뒤 문장은 'Second'로 시작하며 두 번째 이유(사회 다양성)로 전환되므로, 첫 번째 이유(기술·고립)의 마무리에 해당하는 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 적절한 자리는 ②이다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다.

Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm. In a highly connected world where technology doesn't necessarily connect people in a human way, individuals become socially isolated and feel intense loneliness. The invention of portable music players and earphones has made music more personal, too. However, the communal elements persist, manifesting their power in singing events, large and small. Singing with others can be a way to heal and help us feel connected, happy, and healthy. Maybe it is in our genes as a social species. Just open your mouth, start making a sound, and let your voice go. You'll know how good it is almost instantly. 2회차 실전 모의고사
조건 1. <보기>의 단어를 모두 한 번씩 활용할 것 (단, 필요시 형태를 변형할 것)
2. 필요시 단어를 추가할 것
3. 아티스트의 시점으로 they를 주어로 하는 완 전한 절로 쓸 것
보기 memorize / lyric / all / song / sing / along
[Artist's Post] My concert in Korea tonight was completely unforgettable! Before the show, I expected normal reactions from the audience, but Korean fans went far beyond my expectations. What blew my mind the most was that
answer: they memorized the lyrics of all my songs and sang along
solution: 지문에서 'loyal fans ~ memorize the lyrics of all the songs'라고 명시하고 있다. 이를 아티스트 본인의 시점(1인칭 SNS 후기)으로 바꾸어, '내 노래 전부(all my songs)'의 가사를 암기했다는 의미로 'they memorized the lyrics of all my songs'를 쓴다. 이어서 지문의 'singing- along'이라는 표현을 활용하여 '그리고 따라 불렀다'는 의미로 'and sang along'을 쓴다.

body:
다음 중 영영풀이와 단어가 잘못 연결된 것은?
Although group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be beneficial. So why does group singing make us feel so good? Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by reducing stress . and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin. Singing with others has additional benefits. It brings people closer together and helps create bonds that can support self-esteem in a more stable way. The sense of belonging and purpose created in the moment makes us feel connected to others and to something greater. Thus, it's no surprise that people who sing together have healthier minds and more readily participate in their communities. A few studies have reported that people who sang in choirs were more optimistic, less lonely, had stronger relationships, and were more likely to contribute positively to their communities than those who didn't. The good news is that people can enjoy these benefits even when they're singing with others online. Being together is the key. 2회차 실전 모의고사
ⓐbeneficial: harmful to your health or well- being
ⓑreduce: to make something smaller in size or amount
ⓒbond: a close connection between people
ⓓlonely: unhappy because you are alone or without friends
ⓔcontribute: to give something, such as money or help, to a shared goal
solution: ① 제시된 풀이 'harmful to your health or well- being(건강이나 행복에 해로운)'은 beneficial(유익한)의 뜻과 정반대이다. beneficial의 올바른 풀이는 'good for you or having a helpful effect(유익하거나 도움이 되는 효과가 있는)'이다. ② reduce(줄이다): 무언가의 크기나 양을 더 작게 만들다 ③ bond(유대감): 사람들 사이의 긴밀한 연결 ④ lonely(외로운): 혼자이거나 친구 없이 지내서 행복하지 않은 ⑤ contribute(기여하다): 공동의 목표를 위해 돈이나 도움 등을 제공하다
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 내용으로 추론할 수 없는 것은?
The communal nature of music remains and is vividly demonstrated at live concerts. Whether you're in the crowd at the Mercury Lounge or Madison Square Garden, the point is to gather with people who love what you love. If the point wasn't to gather or to share in the mass performance, you'd just stay home and listen to music by yourself. When you sing along to songs at a concert, you don't just listen to the music; you participate in it, "completing" the musical experience. This creates a sense of belonging and a strong bond with the musician. Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them. Maybe it means they have reached the point in their career where they have become popular. Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project.
solution: ④ 콘서트 티켓 가격이 관중과 음악가의 유대감에 영향을 준다는 내용은 지문에 전혀 언급되지 않았으므로 추론할 수 없다. ① 혼자 음악을 들으면 콘서트의 공동체적 경험을 놓치게 된다는 것은, 음악의 공동체적 특성이 콘서트에서 생생히 드러난다는 내용을 바탕으로 추론할 수 있다. ② 관중이 함께 노래를 따라 부르는 것이 음악가가 인기를 얻었다는 신호일 수 있다는 내용을 바탕으로 추론할 수 있다. ③ 오랜 경력의 가수들도 관중의 힘으로 다음 음악 프로젝트에 영감을 받는다는 내용을 바탕으로 추론할 수 있다. ⑤ 집에서 혼자 들으면 음악 경험이 완성되지 않는다는 내용을 바탕으로, 라이브 공연이 집에서의 감상으로는 완전히 대체될 수 없다는 것을 추론할 수 있다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: A person who only listens to music alone may miss the communal aspect of music.
An audience singing along may signal that a musician has gained popularity.
Concerts provide musicians with motivation to continue creating new music.
The ticket price of a concert affects how strongly the audience bonds with musicians.
Live performances offer an experience that cannot be fully replaced by listening at home.

body:
윗글의 밑줄 친 우리말과 일치하도록 괄호 안의 단어들을 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so. 우리가 우리의 사회적 이미 지를 인식하는 한, we can take steps toward finding ways to reduce or even completely overcome this awkwardness.
(our social image, aware of, as long as)
→
answer: As long as we are aware of our social image
solution: 밑줄 친 우리말 '우리가 우리의 사회적 이미지를 인식하는 한'은 'as long as'(~하는 한)를 사용하여 조건의 의미를 표현해야 하며, 주어 'we'와 동사 'are aware of'(~을 인식하다)를 결합하여 'As long as we are aware of our social image'로 완성한다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A),
(B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm. Unlike audiences in some countries where (A) is expected, Korean pop music fans actively engage in tte-chang, even memorizing foreign-language lyrics, making enthusiastic participation a concert (B) _____ .
solution: (A) 일부 나라에서는 관객이 조용히 감상하는 것이 기대된다고 했으므로, 'silence(침묵)'가 가장 적절하다. (B) 한국 팝 음악 콘서트에서 떼창은 규범(norm)이라고 했으므로, 이를 패러프레이즈한 'tradition(전통/관행)'이 가장 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: silence ― tradition
silence ― exception
appreciation ― tradition
appreciation ― standard
participation ― standard

body:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고 르시오.
The communal nature of music remains and is vividly demonstrated at live concerts. Whether you're in the crowd at the Mercury Lounge or Madison Square Garden, the point is to gather with people who love what you love.
(A) This creates a sense of belonging and a strong bond with the musician. Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them.
(B) Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project.
(C) If the point wasn't to gather or to share in the mass performance, you'd just stay home and listen to music by yourself. When you sing along to songs at a concert, you don't just listen to the music; you participate in it, "completing" the musical experience.
solution: 주어진 글은 음악의 공동체적 특성이 라이브 콘서트에서 생생하게 드러나며, 사람들이 같은 음악을 사랑하는 이들과 함께하기 위해 모인다는 화제를 제시한다. (C)는 주어진 글의 '모인다'는 개념을 이어받아 'the point wasn't to gather or to share'라는 표현으로 콘서트에 모이는 이유를 반문하며 구체화하고, 청중이 노래를 따라 부름으로써 음악적 경험을 '완성'한다고 설명한다. (A)는 (C)에서 묘사한 청중의 참여 행위를 'This'로 지칭하며, 그것이 소속감과 뮤지션과의 강한 유대감을 만들어 낸다고 연결하고, 많은 뮤지션들이 청중이 처음 따라 불렀던 순간을 기억한다고 덧붙인다. (B)는 (A)의 '뮤지션들이 청중의 따라 부르기를 특별히 기억한다'는 내용을 받아, 오랜 성공적인 경력을 가진 가수들조차 군중의 힘에 에너지를 얻고 다음 음악 프로젝트에 영감을 받는다는 결론으로 마무리한다. 따라서 (C)-(A)-(B)의 순서가 가장 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
The communal nature of music remains and is vividly demonstrated at live concerts. Whether you're in the crowd at the Mercury Lounge or Madison Square Garden, the point is to gather with people who love what you love. If the point wasn't to gather or to share in the mass performance, you'd just stay home and listen to music by yourself. When you sing along to songs at a concert, you don't just listen to the music; you participate in it, "completing" the musical experience. This creates a sense of belonging and a strong bond with the musician. Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them. Maybe it means they have reached the point in their career where they have become popular. Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project.
solution: ① 콘서트에서 함께 노래를 따라 부르는 행위가 소속감과 음악가와의 강한 유대감을 만들어 낸다고 했으므로, 글의 요지로 가장 적절하다. ② 지문은 혼자 음악을 듣는 것이 최선이라고 하지 않으며, 오히려 함께 모이는 것의 가치를 강조하므로 본문의 내용과 정반대이다. ③ Mercury Lounge와 Madison Square Garden은 콘서트 장소의 예시로 언급된 것일 뿐, 글의 요지는 아니다. ④ 음악가가 매년 새 음악을 발표해야 한다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 콘서트에서 함께 연습하면 노래 실력이 향상된다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다.

Although group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be beneficial. 2회차
ⓐSo why does group singing make us feel so good? Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by reducing stress and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin.
ⓑSinging with others has additional benefits. It brings people closer together and helps create bonds that can support self-esteem in a more stable way.
ⓒLearning to read musical notes and understanding rhythm, however, can take years of formal training and dedication.
ⓓThe sense of belonging and purpose created in the moment makes us feel connected to others and to something greater. Thus, it's no surprise that people who sing together have healthier minds and more readily participate in their communities.
ⓔA few studies have reported that people who sang in choirs were more optimistic, less lonely, had stronger relationships, and were more likely to contribute positively to their communities than those who didn't. The good news is that people can enjoy these benefits even when they're singing with others online. Being together is the key.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하 지 않은 것은?
Numerous surveys consistently highlight the growing trend of teenagers spending extensive hours on social media. This increased usage comes with potential risks, including addiction and exposure to misinformation and inappropriate content. Many adolescents struggle with managing their time and interactions on social media. To address these concerns, certain authorities are implementing legal restrictions on minors' access to social media. Despite these concerns, it is crucial to maintain a balanced perspective that acknowledges the significant advantages that social media can offer. Social media provides an efficient platform for teenagers to express themselves, discover new friendships, and connect with like-minded individuals. Through sharing their thoughts, experiences, and talents, they can find a sense of empowerment and self-identity in the digital world. Research shows the benefits of social media in fostering peer connections and offering essential emotional support, particularly for teens who may ⓐlack such support within their local communities. Additionally, social media serves as a valuable tool for staying ⓑinformed about current events and acquiring knowledge on various subjects. As we weigh these ⓒcontrasting effects of social media, the question of whether regulating teenagers' social media usage should remain a private or public matter is left open. This debate shows the fundamental tension between personal freedoms and societal interests, and it is one that continues to ⓓevolve with the ever- changing digital landscape. Therefore, social media has become increasingly ⓔirrelevant to people's lives and social relationships.
solution: ⓐ lack: 지역사회에서 그러한 지원이 부족한 청소년들을 의미하므로 적절하다. ⓑ informed: stay informed about은 ‘~에 대해 계속 정보를 얻고 있다’라는 의미로 적절하다. ⓒ contrasting: 소셜 미디어의 위험성과 장점을 대조하고 있으므로 적절하다. ⓓ evolve: 변화하는 디지털 환경과 함께 논쟁이 계속 변화한다는 의미로 적절하다. ⓔ irrelevant: 앞에서 소셜 미디어의 위험성과 장점을 모두 논하고, 그것을 둘러싼 규제 문제까지 제시하고 있으므로 소셜 미디어가 사람들의 삶과 사회관계에 ‘점점 관련성이 없어지고 있다’는 것은 문맥과 반대된다. 따라서 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은 ⑤의 ⓔ이다. 비상(홍) Special Unit 2

body:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 낱 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
The communal nature of music remains and is vividly demonstrated at live concerts. Whether you're in the crowd at the Mercury Lounge or Madison Square Garden, the point is to gather with people who love what you love. If the point wasn't to gather or to share in the mass performance, you'd just stay home and listen to music by yourself. When you sing along to songs at a concert, you don't just listen to the music; you participate in it, (A) [complete / completing] the musical experience. This creates a sense of belonging and a strong bond with the musician. Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them. Maybe it means they have reached the point in their career where they have become popular. Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project. Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is (B) [expected / expecting] from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm. In a highly connected world where technology doesn't necessarily connect people in a human way, individuals become socially isolated and feel intense loneliness. The invention of portable music players and earphones has made music more personal, too. However, the communal elements persist, (C) [manifest / manifesting] their power in singing events, large and small. Singing with others can be a way to heal and help us feel connected, happy, and healthy. Maybe it is in our genes as a social species. Just open your mouth, start making a sound, and let your voice go. You'll know how good it is almost instantly. 3회차 실전 모의고사
solution: (A) 앞에 전치사 없이 동사 participate와 병렬 구조를 이루는 분사구문이 삽입된 것이 아니라, 앞 절 전체를 부연 설명하는 분사구문이 필요하므로 completing이 적절하다. (B) appreciation(감사/감상)은 '기대되는' 대상이지 스스로 '기대하는' 주체가 아니므로 수동의 의미인 expected가 적절하다. (C) 주절의 주어 the communal elements가 power를 '드러내는' 행위를 부가적으로 설명하는 분사구문이 필요하므로 manifesting이 적절하다. 따라서 정답은 ⑤이다. ①이 오답인 이유는 (A)에 complete를, (C)에 manifest를 쓰고 있어 두 항목이 모두 틀리기 때문이다. ②가 오답인 이유는 (A)에 complete, (B)에 expecting을 써서 두 항목이 틀리기 때문이다. ③이 오답인 이유는 (C)에 manifest를 써서 분사구문이 성립하지 않기 때문이다. ④가 오답인 이유는 (B)에 expecting, (C)에 manifest를 써서 두 항목이 모두 틀리기 때문이다.

조건 1. <보기>의 표현만을 사용할 것 (중복 없음)
2. <보기>의 형태를 변형하지 말 것
보기 isolation / malady / attachment / separation / connection / individualized / collective / remedy / detachment
(A)
(B)
(C)
(D)
(E)
solution: (A) 기술이 진정한 인간적 연결을 만들지 못한다고 했으므로 'connection(연결)'이 가장 적절하다. (B) 그 결과 사람들이 사회적으로 고립된다고 했으므로 'isolation(고립)'이 가장 적절하다. (C) 함께 노래하는 일이 고립을 치유한다고 했으므로 'remedy(치유책)'가 가장 적절하다. (D) 이어폰이 음악을 더 개인적인 것으로 만들었으므로 'individualized(개인화된)'가 가장 적절하다. (E) 개인적 음악 소비와 달리 함께 노래하는 성격을 나타내므로 'collective(집단적인)'가 가장 적절하다.

다음 글의 논거를 성립시키기 위해 필자가 전제하고 있는 가정으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
The communal nature of music remains and is vividly demonstrated at live concerts. Whether you're in the crowd at the Mercury Lounge or Madison Square Garden, the point is to gather with people who love what you love. If the point wasn't to gather or to share in the mass performance, you'd just stay home and listen to music by yourself. When you sing along to songs at a concert, you don't just listen to the music; you participate in it, "completing" the musical experience. This creates a sense of belonging and a strong bond with the musician. Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them. Maybe it means they have reached the point in their career where they have become popular. Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project.
solution: ⑤ 함께 참여하는 경험이 혼자 듣는 것보다 음악적 경험을 더 온전하게 만든다는 전제가 있어야 관객 참여가 공연을 '완성'한다는 주장이 성립한다. ① 공연장 규모가 음악가의 상업적 성공을 결정한다는 전제는 필요하지 않다. ② 라이브 공연의 음향이 녹음보다 우수하다는 내용은 다루지 않는다. ③ 모든 관객이 사전에 가사를 암기해야 한다는 전제는 제시되지 않았다. ④ 관객이 전문 음악가에게서 영감을 얻어야 한다는 내용은 논거와 관련이 없다. 비상(홍) Special Unit 2
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

The technical quality of live performances being superior to studio recordings.
The ability of fans to memorize lyrics before attending a live musical event.
The psychological need for individuals to seek inspiration from professional musicians.
The idea that active social engagement provides a more complete musical experience than solitary listening.

body:
밑줄 친 부분 중 어법 상 어색한 것을 모두 찾아 기호를 적 고 옳게 고쳐 쓰시오.
Korean pop music fans are ⓐfamous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists ⓑperforming in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte-chang. What's so impressive is ⓒwhat they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event ⓓto make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries
ⓔwhich silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm. ( ), _____ → ( ), _____ →
solution: ⓒ what → that 'What's so impressive is '에서 밑줄 뒤에 이어지는 절 'they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages'는 주어와 동사가 모두 갖추어진 완전한 절이다. 완전한 절을 이끄는 명사절 접속사는 that이어야 하므로, what을 that으로 고쳐야 한다. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사로, 뒤에 불완전한 절이 와야 한다. ⓔ which → where 선행사 'countries'는 장소를 나타내는 명사이며, 뒤에 이어지는 절 'silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience'는 주어·동사·부사구가 모두 갖추어진 완전한 절이다. 따라서 관계대명사 which가 아니라 관계부사 where를 써야 한다. which를 쓰려면 뒤 절에 빠진 성분이 있어야 하는데, 이 절은 완전하므로 which는 어법상 틀리다. ⓐ 'be famous for'는 '~으로 유명하다'라는 의미의 관용 표현으로, 형용사 famous가 보어 자리에 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓑ 'Artists'와 분사 'performing'의 관계를 보면, 아티스트들이 한국에서 공연을 하는 능동의 주체이므로 현재분사 performing이 올바르게 쓰였다. ⓓ 'plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special'에서 to make는 목적(~하기 위해)을 나타내는 부정사의 부사적 용법으로 올바르게 쓰였다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
In a highly connected world where technology doesn't necessarily connect people in a human way, individuals become socially isolated and feel intense loneliness. The invention of portable music players and earphones has made music more personal, too. However, the communal elements persist, manifesting their power in singing events, large and small. Singing with others can be a way to heal and help us feel connected, happy, and healthy. Maybe it is in our genes as a social species. Just open your mouth, start making a sound, and let your voice go. You'll know how good it is almost instantly.
solution: ①이 정답이다. 글에서 "Singing with others can be a way to heal and help us feel connected, happy, and healthy"라고 직접 진술하고 있으므로, 글의 요지로 가장 적절하다. ② 기술이 인간적인 방식으로 사람들을 연결하지는 못한다고 했으므로 글의 내용과 정반대이다. ③ 휴대용 음악 플레이어가 음악을 더 개인적으로 만들었다는 내용은 주제를 이끌어내기 위한 사례일 뿐, 글의 요지는 아니다. ④ 노래 행사의 역사는 글에서 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 글의 핵심은 외로움을 극복할 수 없다는 것이 아니라 함께 노래함으로써 연결감과 건강을 되찾을 수 있다는 것이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: Singing with others helps us feel connected and healthy.
Technology connects people in a deeply human way.
Portable music players make music more enjoyable.
Singing events have a long history in human culture.
Loneliness is impossible to overcome in modern society.

body:
다음 글에서 필자가 주장하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm.
solution: ①이 정답이다. 글 마지막에서 한국 팝 콘서트에서는 떼창과 춤이 동반된 열정적인 참여가 일반적임을 강조하며, 팬들의 적극적인 참여가 음악과 뮤지션을 아끼는 방식임을 주장하고 있으므로, 글의 주장으로 가장 적절하다. ② 글의 핵심은 조용한 감상이 아니라 열정적인 떼창 참여를 긍정적으로 보는 것이므로 정반대이다. ③ 앨범 구매에 대한 내용은 언급되지 않았다. ④ 아티스트가 팬들과 가사를 함께 연습해야 한다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 셋 리스트를 공유해야 한다는 주장은 글에 없으며, 팬들이 셋 리스트를 참고한다는 사실만 서술되어 있다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: 콘서트 관객은 떼창을 통해 음악에 적극적으로 참여해야 한 다.
콘서트 관객은 공연 중에 조용히 감상하는 예절을 지켜야 한 다.
팬들은 콘서트 전에 아티스트의 모든 앨범을 구매해야 한다.
아티스트는 공연 전에 팬들과 가사를 함께 연습해야 한다.
팬들은 콘서트 경험을 특별하게 만들기 위해 셋 리스트를 공 유해야 한다.

body:
밑줄 친 우리말 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. 조용한 감상이 콘서트 관객 으로부터 기대되는 나라들이 있다, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte- chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm.
조건 1. 관계부사와 수동태를 모두 사용할 것
2. [ country, silent, appreciation, expect, from, concert, audience, there ] 에 주어진 단어를 모두 활용할 것
3. 필요 시 어형을 변형할 것
→
answer: There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience.
solution: 먼저 '나라들이 있다'는 'There are countries'로 시작하며, 'country'를 복수형 'countries'로 변형한다. 이어서 관계부사 'where'를 사용해 'countries'를 수식하는 관계부사절을 연결한다. 'where' 절 안에서 '조용한 감상이 기대되다'는 수동태 구조인 'silent appreciation is expected'로 나타내며, 박스의 'expect'를 과거분사 'expected'로 변형하고 'be동사'는 'is'를 직접 추가한다. 마지막으로 '콘서트 관객으로부터'는 'from the concert audience'로 쓴다. 따라서 완성된 문장은 'There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience.'이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them. Maybe it means they have reached the point in their career where they have become popular. Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project.

body:

Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm.
solution: ① 적극적인 떼창이 조용한 감상보다 팬들의 진정한 관심을 더 잘 드러낸다는 전제가 있어야 떼창을 애정의 증거로 보는 결론이 성립한다. ② 외국어 가사 암기의 기술적 난도만으로 팬의 애정을 판단할 수는 없다. ③ 모든 해외 음악가가 큰 소리의 관객을 선호한다는 전제는 필요하지 않다. ④ 떼창 문화의 역사적 형성 과정은 본문의 논거와 직접 관련이 없다. ⑤ 소셜 미디어의 역할은 본문에 제시되지 않았다.

다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A),
(B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Sing Together, Build Bonds Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so. The frequency of group singing has decreased because _____ (A) _____ enables private music consumption and social diversity leads to a decline in _____ (B) _____ musical knowledge.
solution: (A) 기술이 개인 기기를 통한 사적 음악 감상을 가능하게 했으므로 'technology(기술)'가 가장 적절하다. (B) 사회가 다양해져 여러 집단이 공통으로 아는 노래가 줄었으므로 'shared(공유된)'가 가장 적절하다.

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
(A) _____ group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be beneficial. So why does group singing make us feel so good? Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by reducing stress and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin. Singing with others has additional benefits. It brings people closer together and helps create bonds that can support self-esteem in a more stable way. The sense of belonging and purpose created in the moment makes us feel connected to others and to something greater. (B) , it's no surprise that people who sing together have healthier minds and more readily participate in their communities. A few studies have reported that people who sang in choirs were more optimistic, less lonely, had stronger relationships, and were more likely to contribute positively to their communities than those who didn't. The good news is that people can enjoy these benefits even when they're singing with others online. Being together is the key.

The communal nature of music remains and is vividly ⓐdemonstrating at live concerts. solution: ③이 정답이다. "completing"은 분사구문으로, 앞 절 'you participate in it'의 결과·부연을 나타내는 현재분사구문이다. 주어인 you가 능동적으로 '완성하는' 것이므로 현재분사 completing이 올바르게 쓰였다. ① demonstrating → demonstrated 'is vividly demonstrated'는 「be동사 + 과거분사」 형태의 수동태 구문이다. (C) The development of digital music streaming services has also changed the way people purchase and store music.
(D) In a highly connected world where technology doesn't necessarily connect people in a human way, individuals become socially isolated and feel intense loneliness. The invention of portable music players and earphones has made music more personal, too. (E) However, the communal elements persist, manifesting their power in singing events, large and small. Singing with others can be a way to heal and help us feel connected, happy, and healthy. Maybe it is in our genes as a social species. Just open your mouth, start making a sound, and let your voice go. You'll know how good it is almost instantly.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
Old pictures often ⓐdepicts people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons ⓑwhat singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something ⓒ enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us ⓓto feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was ⓔfunnily to do so.
solution: ③ 'something enjoyed privately'에서 enjoyed는 과거분사로 something을 후치 수식한다. something이 enjoy되는 대상(수동 관계)이므로 과거분사 enjoyed가 올바르게 쓰였다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다. ① depicts → depict 주어 'Old pictures'는 복수 명사이므로 복수 동사 depict를 써야 한다. 단수 동사형 depicts는 주어-동사 수 일치 오류이다. ② what → why 선행사 'several reasons'를 수식하는 관계부사 자리이다. '이유'를 나타내는 선행사 뒤에는 관계부사 why를 써야 하며, what은 선행사 없이 명사절을 이끄는 접속사이므로 이 자리에 쓸 수 없다. ④ to feel → feel 사역동사 make는 'make + 목적어 + 동사원형'의 구조를 취한다. 따라서 'make us feel awkward'에서 목적보어 자리에는 동사원형 feel이 와야 하며, to feel은 to부정사이므로 오류이다. ⑤ funnily → fun 'it was to do so'에서 be동사의 보어 자리에는 형용사가 와야 한다. funnily는 부사이므로 보어 자리에 쓸 수 없으며, 형용사 fun으로 고쳐야 한다.

body:
다음 글의 요약을 <조건>에 맞게 완성하시오.
Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm.
<요약>
(A) _____ demonstrates the fans'
(B) _____ and helps them build a special bond _____ (C) _____ .
조건 1. <보기>의 표현만을 모두 사용할 것 (중복 없음)
2. <보기>의 형태를 변형하지 말 것
보기 and prepared / performing / The phenomenon / musicians / of tte-chang / participation / with the / passionate
(A)
(B)
(C)
answer: (A) The phenomenon of tte-chang (B) passionate and prepared participation (C) with the performing musicians
solution: (A) 문장의 주어로 떼창 현상을 나타내므로 'The phenomenon of tte-chang(떼창 현상)'이 가장 적절하다. (B) 팬들이 준비한 열정적인 참여를 목적어로 나타내므로 'passionate and prepared participation(열정적이고 준비된 참여)'이 가장 적절하다. (C) 전치사 with 뒤에서 유대의 상대를 나타내므로 'the performing musicians(공연하는 음악가들)'가 가장 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 내용으로 추론할 수 있는 것은?
In a highly connected world where technology doesn't necessarily connect people in a human way, individuals become socially isolated and feel intense loneliness. The invention of portable music players and earphones has made music more personal, too. However, the communal elements persist, manifesting their power in singing events, large and small. Singing with others can be a way to heal and help us feel connected, happy, and healthy. Maybe it is in our genes as a social species. Just open your mouth, start making a sound, and let your voice go. You'll know how good it is almost instantly.
solution: ③이 정답이다. 지문에서 함께 노래하는 것이 치유의 방법이 될 수 있으며, 이는 사회적 종으로서 우리의 유전자에 새겨진 것일 수도 있다고 언급한다. 이를 통해 인간이 생물학적으로 함께 노래하는 성향을 타고났을 가능성을 추론할 수 있다. ① 지문은 기술이 반드시 사람들을 인간적인 방식으로 연결하지는 않는다고 했으므로, 기술이 항상 유대를 강화한다고 추론할 수 없다. ② 지문은 휴대용 음악 재생기가 음악을 더 개인적으로 만들었다고 했을 뿐, 집단 노래를 장려하기 위해 발명되었다는 내용은 없으므로 추론할 수 없다. ④ 지문은 공동체적 요소가 지속된다고 했을 뿐, 노래 행사가 모든 공동체 형태를 대체했다고 추론할 수 없다. ⑤ 지문은 타인과 함께 노래하는 것의 효과를 언급할 뿐, 혼자 노래하는 것과의 비교는 다루지 않으므로 추론할 수 없다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: Technology always strengthens human bonds in modern society.
Portable music players were invented to encourage group singing.
Humans may be biologically inclined to sing together with others.
Singing events have recently replaced all other forms of community.
The benefits of singing alone are equal to those of singing with others.

body:
다음 중 영영풀이와 단어가 잘못 연결된 것은?
Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm.
ⓐconventional: following what has always been done; traditional
ⓑmemorize: to forget something completely so that you cannot recall it
ⓒloyal: faithful and continuing to support someone or something
ⓓenthusiastic: showing great excitement and interest
ⓔaccompany: to happen or exist at the same time as something else
solution: ②가 정답이다. 제시된 풀이 'to forget something completely so that you cannot recall it(완전히 잊어버려서 기억할 수 없다)'은 memorize(암기하다)의 뜻과 정반대이다. memorize의 올바른 풀이는 'to learn something so that you can remember it exactly(정확히 기억할 수 있도록 무언가를 배우다)'이다. ① conventional(관습적인): 일반적으로 해 온 방식을 따르는; 전통적인 ③ loyal(충실한): 누군가 또는 무언가를 계속해서 지지하는; 충성스러운 ④ enthusiastic(열정적인): 큰 흥분과 관심을 보이는 ⑤ accompany(동반하다): 다른 것과 동시에 일어나거나 존재하다
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
The communal nature of music remains and is vividly demonstrated at live concerts. Whether you're in the crowd at the Mercury Lounge or Madison Square Garden, the point is to gather with people who love what you love. If the point wasn't to gather or to share in the mass performance, you'd just stay home and listen to music by yourself. When you sing along to songs at a concert, you don't just listen to the music; you participate in it, "completing" the musical experience. This creates a sense of belonging and a strong bond with the musician. Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them. Maybe it means they have reached the point in their career where they have become popular. Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project.
solution: ③ 지문에서는 콘서트에서 함께 노래를 따라 부르는 것이 음악가와의 강한 유대감을 만들어 낸다고 했으므로, 유대감을 약화시킨다는 선택지는 지문의 내용과 정반대이다. ① 음악의 공동체적 특성이 라이브 콘서트에서 생생하게 드러난다는 내용과 일치한다. ② 콘서트에 가는 목적은 같은 음악을 좋아하는 사람들과 함께 모이는 것이라는 내용과 일치한다. ④ 많은 음악가들이 관중이 처음으로 자신과 함께 노래를 따라 불렀던 순간을 기억한다는 내용과 일치한다. ⑤ 오랜 경력을 가진 가수들도 관중의 힘으로 활력을 얻는다는 내용과 일치한다. 비상(홍) Special Unit 2
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: The communal nature of music is demonstrated at live concerts.
The purpose of attending a concert is to gather with people who share the same taste.
Singing along at a concert weakens the bond between the audience and the musician.
Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them.
Even experienced singers feel energized by the power of the crowd.

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
Although group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be ⓐbeneficial. So why does group singing make us feel so good? Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by ⓑreducing stress and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin. Singing with others has additional benefits. It brings people closer together and helps create
ⓒbonds that can support self-esteem in a more stable way. The sense of belonging and purpose created in the moment makes us feel ⓓisolated to others and to something greater. Thus, it's no surprise that people who sing together have healthier minds and more readily participate in their communities. A few studies have reported that people who sang in choirs were more optimistic, less lonely, had stronger relationships, and were more likely to ⓔcontribute positively to their communities than those who didn't.
solution: ④ isolated → connected 지문의 흐름상 소속감과 목적의식이 '우리를 타인과 더 큰 무언가에 연결되게 한다'는 내용이 되어야 하므로, isolated(고립된)는 connected(연결된)로 바꿔야 한다. ① beneficial: 유익한, 이로운 ② reducing: 줄이는, 감소시키는 ③ bonds: 유대, 결속 ⑤ contribute: 기여하다, 공헌하다
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so.
solution: ①이 정답이다. 글은 그룹으로 노래하는 것이 덜 일반화된 여러 이유(고립화, 기술, 다양성, 오락 선택지 증가)를 설명하고 있으므로, 글의 제목으로 가장 적절하다. ② 기술이 음악을 통해 사람들을 연결한다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다. 오히려 기술이 음악을 개인적으로 즐기게 만든다고 서술한다. ③ 교회에서의 노래 역사는 도입부의 배경 설명으로 언급된 사례일 뿐, 글의 제목은 아니다. ④ 다양성이 지역 행사를 개선하는 열쇠라는 내용은 언급되지 않았다. ⑤ 오락 선택지의 증가는 그룹 노래가 줄어든 이유 중 하나로 언급될 뿐이며, 사람들을 하나로 모은다는 방향과는 반대이다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사
choices: Why We Have Stopped Singing Together
How Technology Connects Us Through Music
The Long History of Singing in Churches
Diversity: The Key to Better Community Events
Entertainment Options That Bring People Together 4회차 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 내용을 재구성하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A)~(E)를 <조 건>에 맞게 완성하시오.
Sing Together, Build Bonds Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so.
<재구성> In the past, communal singing was a frequent social activity, but it has declined for several reasons. One major factor is that modern technology allows people to experience music
(A) _____ rather than in social gatherings. Furthermore, the increasing
(B) _____ of our society results in a lack of shared musical knowledge. People also hesitate to sing in public because they are
(C) _____ about how others perceive them. While people previously found
(D) _____ in singing together, the abundance of modern entertainment has made this tradition less _____ (E) _____ than it once was.
조건 1. <보기>의 표현만을 사용할 것 (중복 없음)
2. <보기>의 형태를 변형하지 말 것
보기 prevalent / privately / diversity / uniformity / concerned / indifferent / publicly / scarce / pleasure / pressure
(A)
(B)
(C)
(D)
(E) 4회차 실전 모의고사
solution: (A) 음악을 개인 기기로 사적으로 즐기게 되었다고 했으므로 'privately(사적으로)'가 가장 적절하다. (B) 사회가 더 다양해졌다고 했으므로 'diversity(다양성)'가 가장 적절하다. (C) 사람들이 타인의 시선을 걱정한다고 했으므로 'concerned(걱정하는)'가 가장 적절하다. (D) 과거에는 함께 노래하는 일을 즐거워했다고 했으므로 'pleasure(즐거움)'가 가장 적절하다. (E) 오늘날 공동체 가창이 과거보다 덜 흔해졌으므로 'prevalent(널리 행해지는)'가 가장 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
Old pictures often depict people ⓐsinging together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier
ⓑenjoying music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of ⓒbeing played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music ⓓthat is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past ⓔwhen people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so.
solution: ② enjoying → to enjoy 'make it + 형용사 + to-V' 구조에서 진목적어 자리에는 to부정사가 와야 한다. 'Technology has made it easier to enjoy music'처럼 가목적어 it을 받는 진목적어 자리에는 to부정사를 써야 하므로, enjoying을 to enjoy로 고쳐야 한다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다. ① 'depict people singing'은 묘사 동사 depict의 목적보어 자리에 현재분사 singing이 쓰인 것으로, '사람들이 함께 노래하는 것을 묘사하다'라는 능동의 의미를 나타내므로 올바르게 쓰였다. ③ 'Instead of being played'는 전치사 Instead of 뒤에 동명사구(수동형)가 온 구조로, '음악이 연주되는 것' 대신이라는 수동의 의미를 나타내므로 올바르게 쓰였다. ④ 선행사 'The list of music'을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that이 올바르게 쓰였다. that 이하의 절에서 주어 역할을 하며 단수 동사 is와 수 일치도 적절하다. ⑤ 선행사 'the past'를 수식하는 관계부사 when이 올바르게 쓰였다. when 이하 절에서 'people gathered around the piano'로 완전한 절이 이어지므로, 관계부사 when의 사용이 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
윗글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적 절한 곳은?
Singing with others has additional benefits. Although group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be beneficial. (
ⓐ ) So why does group singing make us feel so good? ( ⓑ ) Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by reducing stress and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin. ( ⓒ ) It brings people closer together and helps create bonds that can support self-esteem in a more stable way. The sense of belonging and purpose created in the moment makes us feel connected to others and to something greater. ( ⓓ ) Thus, it's no surprise that people who sing together have healthier minds and more readily participate in their communities. A few studies have reported that people who sang in choirs were more optimistic, less lonely, had stronger relationships, and were more likely to contribute positively to their communities than those who didn't. ( ⓔ ) The good news is that people can enjoy these benefits even when they're singing with others online. Being together is the key.
solution: 주어진 문장 'Singing with others has additional benefits.'는 혼자 노래할 때의 효과(스트레스 감소, 행복 호르몬 분비)를 설명한 내용 뒤에 위치해야 하며, 이어지는 문장 'It brings people closer together...'의 'It'이 'Singing with others'를 가리키므로 ③이 가장 적절하다. ①은 글의 도입부로 아직 노래의 효과가 언급되지 않아 부적절하다. ②가 들어가면 개인적 효과를 설명하는 문장과 주어진 문장 사이에 자연스러운 흐름이 끊긴다. ④가 들어가면 'It brings people closer...'라는 구체적 설명이 뒤에 남아 논리적 순서가 맞지 않는다. ⑤가 들어가면 이미 합창 연구 결과까지 제시된 후라 'additional benefits'를 소개하기에 너무 늦다. 비상(홍) Special Unit 2
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고 르시오.
Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays.
(A) The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so.
(B) There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more isolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting.
(C) Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed privately on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs.
solution: 주어진 글은 옛 그림에서 사람들이 함께 노래하는 장면을 묘사하며, 오늘날 그런 모습이 드물어졌다는 화제를 제시한다. (B)는 'There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common'으로 주어진 글의 '이런 장면이 줄어들었다'는 내용을 직접 받아 첫 번째 이유 (기술로 인한 고립)를 제시하며 자연스럽게 이어진다. (C)는 'Instead of being played in a large setting'이라는 대조 표지로 (B)의 기술이 개인적 음악 감상을 가능하게 했다는 내용을 구체화하고, 'Second'로 두 번째 이유(사회 다양성)를 도입하며 연결된다. (A)는 'The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming shorter'로 (C)의 사회 다양성 내용을 이어받아 세 번째 이유(오락 선택지 증가)까지 마무리하며 글을 마친다. 따라서 (B)-(C)-(A)의 순서가 가장 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm.
solution: ①이 정답이다. 글 전반에 걸쳐 한국 팝 음악 팬들이 떼창이라는 독특한 참여 문화를 통해 음악과 뮤지션을 아끼는 모습을 설명하고 있으므로, 글의 주제로 가장 적절하다. ② 한국 팝 음악 콘서트의 역사는 언급되지 않았다. ③ 외국어 가사를 외우는 구체적인 방법은 글에서 다루지 않는다. ④ 글의 핵심은 조용한 감상이 아니라 적극적인 떼창 참여 문화이다. ⑤ 한국 아티스트가 해외에서 공연하는 이유는 언급되지 않았다.

body:
다음 글의 요약을 <조건>에 맞게 완성하시오.
Although group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be beneficial. So why does group singing make us feel so good? Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by reducing stress and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin. Singing with others has additional benefits. It brings people closer together and helps create bonds that can support self-esteem in a more stable way. The sense of belonging and purpose created in the moment makes us feel connected to others and to something greater. Thus, it's no surprise that people who sing together have healthier minds and more readily participate in their communities. A few studies have reported that people who sang in choirs were more optimistic, less lonely, had stronger relationships, and were more likely to contribute positively to their communities than those who didn't. The good news is that people can enjoy these benefits even when they're singing with others online. Being together is the key.
<요약> Group singing serves as a catalyst for
(A) _____ and _____ (B) _____ , regardless of _____ (C) _____ .
조건 1. <보기>의 표현만을 모두 사용할 것 (중복 없음)
2. <보기>의 형태를 변형하지 말 것 4회차 실전 모의고사
보기 or online / relationships / fostering / social / is performed / health / it / improving / in person / whether / psychological
(A)
(B)
(C)
answer: (A) improving psychological health (B) fostering social relationships (C) whether it is performed in person or online
solution: (A) 집단 가창이 정신 건강을 증진한다고 했으므로 'improving psychological health(심리적 건강 증진)'가 가장 적절하다. (B) 함께 노래하면 사회적 유대가 형성되므로 'fostering social relationships(사회적 관계 형성)'가 가장 적절하다. (C) 온라인에서도 같은 이점을 누릴 수 있다고 했으므로 'whether it is performed in person or online(대면 또는 온라인 여부와 관계없이)'이 가장 적절하다.
source: 영어플랫 · 비상(홍) Special Unit 2 실전 모의고사

다음 글의 다음에 이어질 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
The communal nature of music remains and is vividly demonstrated at live concerts. Whether you're in the crowd at the Mercury Lounge or Madison Square Garden, the point is to gather with people who love what you love. If the point wasn't to gather or to share in the mass performance, you'd just stay home and listen to music by yourself. When you sing along to songs at a concert, you don't just listen to the music; you participate in it, "completing" the musical experience. This creates a sense of belonging and a strong bond with the musician. Many musicians remember the first time their audience sang along with them. Maybe it means they have reached the point in their career where they have become popular. Even singers with long, successful careers feel energized by the power of the crowd and get inspired for their next music project. Korean pop music fans are famous for their singing-along during concerts, and their participation in the concert sometimes goes beyond the conventional expectations of musicians. Artists performing in Korea are often impressed by the audience singing, called tte- chang. What's so impressive is that they memorize entire songs in English or even in other foreign languages. Before going to a concert, loyal fans look at the set list, memorize the lyrics of all the songs, and plan a tte-chang event to make their concert experience special. In this way, Korean fans show that they really care about the music and the musicians. There are countries where silent appreciation is expected from the concert audience, but at Korean pop music concerts, enthusiastic participation in tte-chang often accompanied by dancing is the norm. In a highly connected world where technology doesn't necessarily connect people in a human way, individuals become socially isolated and feel intense loneliness. The invention of portable music players and earphones has made music more personal, too. However, the communal elements persist, manifesting their power in singing events, large and small. Singing with others can be a way to heal and help us feel connected, happy, and healthy. Maybe it is in our genes as a social species. Just open your mouth, start making a sound, and let your voice go. You'll know how good it is almost instantly. 4회차
solution: 지문 마지막 단락은 함께 노래하는 것이 치유와 연결감·행복· 건강에 도움이 될 수 있으며, 이것이 사회적 종으로서 우리 유전자에 새겨진 것일 수도 있다고 언급하며 마무리된다. 따라서 다음에 이어질 내용으로는 함께 노래하는 행위가 왜 치유 효과를 지니는지에 대한 과학적 설명이 가장 자연스럽다. ①이 이어폰으로 혼자 음악을 듣는 것의 이점은 지문의 공동체적 음악 경험 강조 방향과 반대되어 적절하지 않다. ②가 조용한 콘서트에 대한 문화적 차이는 이미 본문에서 다루어진 내용이므로 '다음'에 이어질 내용으로 적절하지 않다. ④가 스트리밍 서비스로 인한 라이브 콘서트의 인기 하락은 지문의 흐름과 무관하다. ⑤가 기술이 공동체적 음악 경험을 대체했다는 내용은 지문이 제시하는 방향과 정반대이므로 적절하지 않다.

Sing Together, Build Bonds Old pictures often depict people singing together in church, with their families at home or with companions at community events. Unfortunately, these scenes have become less common nowadays. There could be several reasons why singing in a group has become less common. First, we spend less time in groups these days and are more ⓐisolated. Technology has made it easier to enjoy music individually rather than in a larger setting. Instead of being played in a large setting and under social circumstances, music has become something enjoyed ⓑpublicly on our personal play devices. Second, our society is more diverse, so we don't always know the same songs. The list of music that is common to different groups of people is becoming ⓒshorter. We might also worry more about our social image, and singing in front of others can make us feel awkward. Lastly, we have more entertainment options today than in the past when people gathered around the piano or the guitar just because it was fun to do so. Although group singing has become less common, it's an activity that can be beneficial. So why does group singing make us feel so good? Decades of research have shown that singing is good for you on many levels by ⓓincreasing stress and increasing the release of happiness hormones such as endorphins, dopamine, and serotonin.
